description: Amtliches Festpunktinformationssystem MV (WMS_MV_AFIS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten-mv.de. The Web Map Service for the Official Fixed Point Information System (AFIS) of the State of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern presents the official location, altitude and gravity fixed points as well as the reference station points including their point numbers. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Official Fixed Point Information System MV (WMS _MV _AFIS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AdVMIS, opendata, Referenzstationspunkte, AFIS, AdV, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
